# Flu and Ebola

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FLU 2009 H1N1 + EBOLA SIERRA LEONE 2014
# Full analysis using estimate_R_blocks() (odin2 → dust2 → monty)
# ============================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dust2); library(monty); library(odin2)
library(ggplot2); library(EpiEstim)
library(dplyr); library(outbreaks); library(patchwork); library(devtools)

set.seed(444)
load_all()

# ============================================================
# SHARED HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# --- S(t) trajectory plot ---
plot_S_trajectory <- function(out, N, title_label = "") {
  df <- out$S_quantiles
  ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = "#56B4E9", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = "#56B4E9", linewidth = 1.1) +
    labs(
      x        = "Time (days)",
      y        = "S(t) — susceptible individuals",
      title    = paste0(title_label, " — Posterior S(t)"),
      subtitle = paste0("Posterior median and 95% CI, N = ",
                        format(N, big.mark = ","))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
}

# --- Smooth Rt(t) plot ---
plot_Rt <- function(out, title_label = "Rt(t)", vlines = NULL) {
  df <- out$Rt_quantiles
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "red") +
    labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt",
         title    = title_label,
         subtitle = "Posterior median and 95% CI") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  if (!is.null(vlines))
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
                        color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7)
  p
}

# --- Block Rt from Rt_mat ---
block_Rt <- function(Rt_mat, beta_times, time_vec) {
  K   <- length(beta_times)
  out <- data.frame()
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    t_start     <- beta_times[k]
    t_end       <- if (k < K) beta_times[k + 1] - 1 else max(time_vec)
    idx         <- which(time_vec >= t_start & time_vec <= t_end)
    block_draws <- Rt_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(
      t_start = t_start,
      t_end   = t_end,
      Mean    = mean(block_draws),
      Lower   = quantile(block_draws, 0.025),
      Upper   = quantile(block_draws, 0.975)
    ))
  }
  out
}

# --- Block Rt plot ---
plot_block_Rt <- function(df_blocks, title_label = "", vlines = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df_blocks) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = t_start, xmax = t_end, ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
              fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = t_start, xend = t_end, y = Mean, yend = Mean),
                 color = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
    labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt",
         title    = paste0(title_label, " — rodent: Block Rt"),
         subtitle = "Mean and 95% CI per block") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  if (!is.null(vlines))
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
                        color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7)
  p
}

# --- beta(t) block plot from Rt_mat / beta_t_mat ---
plot_beta_blocks <- function(out, vlines = NULL, title_label = "") {
  beta_mat <- out$beta_t_mat
  bt       <- out$beta_times
  time_vec <- out$Rt_quantiles$time
  K        <- length(bt)

  rows <- lapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
    t_start <- bt[k]
    t_end   <- if (k < K) bt[k + 1] - 1 else max(time_vec)
    idx     <- which(time_vec >= t_start & time_vec <= t_end)
    draws   <- beta_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(
      t_start = t_start,
      t_end   = t_end,
      median  = median(draws),
      lower   = quantile(draws, 0.025),
      upper   = quantile(draws, 0.975)
    )
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)

  p <- ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = t_start, xmax = t_end, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "#6A51A3", alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = t_start, xend = t_end, y = median, yend = median),
                 color = "#6A51A3", linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "butt") +
    labs(x = "Time (days)", y = expression(beta(t)),
         title    = paste0(title_label, " — rodent: β(t) blockwise"),
         subtitle = "Posterior median and 95% CI by block") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
  if (!is.null(vlines))
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
                        color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.6)
  p
}

# --- rodent vs EpiEstim comparison plot ---
make_comparison_plot <- function(df_epi, df_rod, vlines = NULL,
                                 title_label = "") {
  span <- max(df_rod$t_end) - min(df_rod$t_start)
  df <- bind_rows(
    df_epi %>% mutate(method = "EpiEstim"),
    df_rod %>% mutate(method = "rodent")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      x_start = ifelse(method == "rodent",
                       t_start + 0.02 * span, t_start - 0.02 * span),
      x_end   = ifelse(method == "rodent",
                       t_end   + 0.02 * span, t_end   - 0.02 * span)
    )
  p <- ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = x_start, xmax = x_end,
                  ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, fill = method),
              alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end,
                     y = Mean, yend = Mean, color = method),
                 linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("EpiEstim" = "#E69F00",
                                  "rodent"   = "#0072B2")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("EpiEstim" = "#E69F00",
                                  "rodent"   = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt",
         title    = paste0(title_label, " — Block Rt comparison"),
         subtitle = "Orange = EpiEstim, Blue = rodent",
         fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (!is.null(vlines))
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
                        color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.6)
  p
}

# --- numeric summary printer ---
print_Rt_comparison <- function(df_epi, df_rod, label = "") {
  cat("\n=====", label, "— Rt COMPARISON =====\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_epi))) {
    cat(sprintf("Block %d (days %d-%d):\n", i,
                df_epi$t_start[i], df_epi$t_end[i]))
    cat(sprintf("  EpiEstim : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
                df_epi$Mean[i], df_epi$Lower[i], df_epi$Upper[i]))
    cat(sprintf("  rodent   : %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n\n",
                df_rod$Mean[i], df_rod$Lower[i], df_rod$Upper[i]))
  }
}

# Summarise Rt_mat on user-specified block windows (t_start, t_end)
block_Rt_on_windows <- function(Rt_mat, time_vec, t_start, t_end) {
  stopifnot(length(t_start) == length(t_end))
  purrr::map2_dfr(t_start, t_end, function(a, b) {
    idx <- which(time_vec >= a & time_vec <= b)
    draws <- Rt_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    # Drop empty windows robustly
    if (length(idx) == 0 || all(!is.finite(draws))) {
      return(data.frame(t_start = a, t_end = b,
                        Mean = NA_real_, Lower = NA_real_, Upper = NA_real_))
    }
    data.frame(
      t_start = a, t_end = b,
      Mean  = mean(draws),
      Lower = as.numeric(stats::quantile(draws, 0.025)),
      Upper = as.numeric(stats::quantile(draws, 0.975))
    )
  })
}



# ============================================================
# DATASET 1: FLU 2009 H1N1
# ============================================================
data(Flu2009)
flu_daily <- Flu2009$incidence %>%
  mutate(time = row_number()) %>%
  rename(cases = I) %>%
  select(time, cases) %>%
  as.data.frame()

flu_vlines <- c(8, 18, 25)
Tmax_flu   <- nrow(flu_daily)

cat("=== FLU 2009 H1N1 ===\n")
cat("Total cases:",      sum(flu_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Peak daily cases:", max(flu_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Day of peak:",      which.max(flu_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Total days:",       Tmax_flu, "\n\n")

# --- Fit rodent ---
flu_out <- estimate_R_blocks(
  data        = flu_daily,
  N           = 369,
  gamma       = 1 / 2.6,
  beta_breaks = c(1, 8, 18, 25),
  priors = list(mean_beta  = log(0.5), sd_beta    = 1.0,
                rw_sd_beta = 0.3,      mean_I0    = log(5), sd_I0 = 0.5),
  inits  = list(beta = 0.5, I0 = 5),
  mcmc   = list(n_steps = 15000, burnin = 0.5, seed = 444, n_chains = 3)
)

# --- rodent outputs ---
flu_blocks <- block_Rt(flu_out$Rt_mat, flu_out$beta_times, flu_daily$time)

# --- EpiEstim ---
flu_epi <- flu_daily %>% rename(I = cases)

res_flu_sliding_7d <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi, method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 2.6, std_si = 1.5,
    t_start = seq(2, Tmax_flu - 6),
    t_end   = seq(2, Tmax_flu - 6) + 6
  ))
)

res_flu_np <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi, method = "non_parametric_si",
  config = make_config(si_distr = Flu2009$si_distr)
)

res_flu_blocks_param <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi, method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 2.6, std_si = 1.5,
    t_start = c(2, 8, 18, 25),
    t_end   = c(7, 17, 24, Tmax_flu)
  ))
)

res_flu_blocks_np <- estimate_R(
  incid  = flu_epi, method = "non_parametric_si",
  config = make_config(
    si_distr = Flu2009$si_distr,
    t_start  = c(2, 8, 18, 25),
    t_end    = c(7, 17, 24, Tmax_flu)
  )
)

df_epi_flu_param <- res_flu_blocks_param$R %>%
  transmute(t_start, t_end, Mean = `Mean(R)`,
            Lower = `Quantile.0.025(R)`, Upper = `Quantile.0.975(R)`)

df_epi_flu_np <- res_flu_blocks_np$R %>%
  transmute(t_start, t_end, Mean = `Mean(R)`,
            Lower = `Quantile.0.025(R)`, Upper = `Quantile.0.975(R)`)

df_rod_flu <- flu_blocks %>%
  transmute(t_start, t_end, Mean, Lower, Upper)

# ============================================================
# FLU PLOTS — individual
# ============================================================

# P1: Incidence
p_flu_incid <- ggplot(flu_daily, aes(time, cases)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#56B4E9", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = flu_vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = 19, y = max(flu_daily$cases) * 0.93,
           label = "School\nclosure", hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(x = "Time (days)", y = "Daily cases",
       title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — Daily Incidence",
       subtitle = "Pennsylvania school, N = 369") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
print(p_flu_incid)

# P2: rodent smooth Rt(t)
p_flu_rt <- plot_Rt(flu_out, "Flu 2009 H1N1 — rodent: Rt(t)", flu_vlines)
print(p_flu_rt)

# P3: rodent block Rt
p_flu_blocks <- plot_block_Rt(flu_blocks, "Flu 2009 H1N1", flu_vlines)
print(p_flu_blocks)

# P4: EpiEstim 7-day sliding (parametric)
p_flu_epi_7d <- plot(res_flu_sliding_7d, "R") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = flu_vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — EpiEstim: 7-day sliding Rt",
       subtitle = "Parametric SI: mean = 2.6d, sd = 1.5d") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
print(p_flu_epi_7d)

# P5: EpiEstim non-parametric SI (7-day)
p_flu_epi_np <- plot(res_flu_np, "R") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = flu_vlines, linetype = "dotted",
             color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — EpiEstim: non-parametric SI",
       subtitle = "Empirical SI distribution from Flu2009$si_distr") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
print(p_flu_epi_np)

# P6: EpiEstim parametric block windows
p_flu_epi_blocks_param <- plot(res_flu_blocks_param, "R") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  labs(title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — EpiEstim: block windows (parametric SI)",
       subtitle = "Blocks: days 2-7, 8-17, 18-24, 25-end") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
print(p_flu_epi_blocks_param)

# P7: EpiEstim non-parametric block windows
p_flu_epi_blocks_np <- plot(res_flu_blocks_np, "R") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  labs(title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — EpiEstim: block windows (non-parametric SI)",
       subtitle = "Blocks: days 2-7, 8-17, 18-24, 25-end") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
print(p_flu_epi_blocks_np)

# P8: rodent vs EpiEstim parametric block comparison
p_flu_compare_param <- make_comparison_plot(
  df_epi_flu_param, df_rod_flu, flu_vlines,
  "Flu 2009 H1N1 (parametric SI)"
)
print(p_flu_compare_param)

# P9: rodent vs EpiEstim non-parametric block comparison
p_flu_compare_np <- make_comparison_plot(
  df_epi_flu_np, df_rod_flu, flu_vlines,
  "Flu 2009 H1N1 (non-parametric SI)"
)
print(p_flu_compare_np)

# P10: S(t)
p_flu_S <- plot_S_trajectory(flu_out, N = 369, "Flu 2009 H1N1")
print(p_flu_S)

# P11: beta(t) blocks
p_flu_beta <- plot_beta_blocks(flu_out, flu_vlines, "Flu 2009 H1N1")
print(p_flu_beta)

# P12: rodent Rt(t) vs EpiEstim NP stacked two-panel
p_flu_two_panel <- p_flu_rt / p_flu_epi_np +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — Rt comparison",
    subtitle = "Top: rodent | Bottom: EpiEstim non-parametric SI",
    theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey40"))
  )
print(p_flu_two_panel)

# P13: beta(t) and S(t) stacked
p_flu_beta_S <- p_flu_beta / p_flu_S +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Flu 2009 H1N1 — β(t) and S(t)",
    subtitle = "Top: β(t) block posterior | Bottom: S(t) trajectory",
    theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey40"))
  )
print(p_flu_beta_S)

# Numeric summaries
print_Rt_comparison(df_epi_flu_param, df_rod_flu, "FLU 2009 (parametric SI)")
print_Rt_comparison(df_epi_flu_np,    df_rod_flu, "FLU 2009 (non-parametric SI)")

# DATASET 2: EBOLA SIERRA LEONE 2014
# ============================================================
data(ebola_sierraleone_2014)
ebola_daily <- ebola_sierraleone_2014 %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_of_onset)) %>%
  group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
  summarise(cases = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(date_of_onset) %>%
  mutate(time = row_number()) %>%
  select(time, cases) %>%
  as.data.frame()

ebola_vlines <- c(100, 180, 240)
Tmax_ebola   <- nrow(ebola_daily)

cat("=== EBOLA SIERRA LEONE 2014 ===\n")
cat("Total cases:",      sum(ebola_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Peak daily cases:", max(ebola_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Day of peak:",      which.max(ebola_daily$cases), "\n")
cat("Total days:",       Tmax_ebola, "\n\n")

# --- Fit rodent ---
ebola_out <- estimate_R_blocks(
  data        = ebola_daily,
  N           = 8600000,
  gamma       = 0.1,           # ~10-day infectious period for Ebola
  beta_breaks = c(1, 100, 180, 240),
  priors = list(mean_beta  = log(0.2), sd_beta    = 1.0,
                rw_sd_beta = 0.3,      mean_I0    = log(5), sd_I0 = 0.5),
  inits  = list(beta = 0.2, I0 = 5),
  mcmc   = list(n_steps = 15000, burnin = 0.5, seed = 444, n_chains = 3)
)

# --- rodent outputs ---
ebola_blocks <- block_Rt(ebola_out$Rt_mat, ebola_out$beta_times,
                         ebola_daily$time)

# --- EpiEstim ---
ebola_epi <- ebola_daily %>% rename(I = cases)

res_ebola_sliding_7d <- estimate_R(
  incid  = ebola_epi, method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 14.2, std_si = 9.6,
    t_start = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 6),
    t_end   = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 6) + 6
  ))
)

res_ebola_sliding_14d <- estimate_R(
  incid  = ebola_epi, method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 14.2, std_si = 9.6,
    t_start = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 13),
    t_end   = seq(2, Tmax_ebola - 13) + 13
  ))
)

res_ebola_blocks <- estimate_R(
  incid  = ebola_epi, method = "parametric_si",
  config = make_config(list(
    mean_si = 14.2, std_si = 9.6,
    t_start = c(2,   100, 180, 240),
    t_end   = c(99, 179, 239, Tmax_ebola)
  ))
)

df_epi_ebola <- res_ebola_blocks$R %>%
  transmute(t_start, t_end, Mean = `Mean(R)`,
            Lower = `Quantile.0.025(R)`, Upper = `Quantile.0.975(R)`)

df_rod_ebola <- ebola_blocks %>%
  transmute(t_start, t_end, Mean, Lower, Upper)

# ============================================================
# EBOLA PLOTS — individual
# ============================================================

# P1: Incidence
p_ebola_incid <- ggplot(ebola_daily, aes(time, cases)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#56B4E9", alpha = 0.8) +

# P10: rodent Rt(t) vs EpiEstim 14-day stacked two-panel
p_ebola_two_panel <- p_ebola_rt / p_ebola_epi_14d +

# P11: beta(t) and S(t) stacked
p_ebola_beta_S <- p_ebola_beta / p_ebola_S +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Ebola Sierra Leone 2014 — β(t) and S(t)",
```

# Simulations

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FULL SIMULATION VALIDATION SCRIPT
# rodent — thesis analysis
#
# Three main scenarios (depletion gradient):
#   S1: N=5,000    gradual decline     R0: 1.4→1.12→0.88  γ=0.25  I0=10
#   S2: N=100,000  COVID-19 lockdown   R0: 2.8→0.85        γ=0.1   I0=50
#   S3: N=10,000,000 influenza-like    R0: 1.6→1.3→1.1     γ=1/3   I0=10
#
# Additional analyses (assigned to maximally informative scenario):
#   A. RW prior sensitivity          → S1  (well-identified, depletion meaningful)
#   B. Beta mean misspecification    → S2  (abrupt change point, hard test)
#   C. I0 prior mean misspecification → S1  (depletion makes I0 matter most)
#   D. Coverage vs N                 → S2  (hard recovery profile, abrupt drop)
#   E. Convergence diagnostics       → S1  (showcase scenario, most informative)
# ============================================================

library(dust2)
library(odin2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(coda)       # for R-hat / ESS diagnostics

set.seed(444)
load_all()

# ============================================================
# COLOUR PALETTES
# ============================================================
prior_colours <- c(
  "P1: Weak (rw=0.5)"     = "#56B4E9",
  "P2: Moderate (rw=0.2)" = "#009E73",
  "P3: Tight (rw=0.05)"   = "#E69F00"
)

misspec_colours_beta <- c(
  "Undershoot (log(0.05))" = "#D55E00",
  "Near-truth (log(0.18))" = "#009E73",
  "Overshoot (log(0.8))"   = "#CC79A7"
)

misspec_colours_I0 <- c(
  "Low (log(2))"    = "#D55E00",
  "Truth (log(10))" = "#009E73",
  "High (log(50))"  = "#CC79A7"
)

theme_val <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ============================================================
# SHARED SIR SIMULATION MODEL
# ============================================================
simple_sir <- odin2::odin({
  N      <- parameter()
  I0     <- parameter()
  gamma  <- parameter()
  n_beta <- parameter()
  beta_times  <- parameter()
  beta_values <- parameter()
  dim(beta_times)  <- n_beta
  dim(beta_values) <- n_beta
  beta_t <- interpolate(beta_times, beta_values, "constant")
  initial(S) <- N - I0
  initial(I) <- I0
  initial(incidence, zero_every = 1) <- 0
  p_SI <- 1 - exp(-beta_t * I / N * dt)
  p_IR <- 1 - exp(-gamma * dt)
  n_SI <- S * p_SI
  n_IR <- I * p_IR
  update(S) <- S - n_SI
  update(I) <- I + n_SI - n_IR
  update(incidence) <- n_SI
  cases <- data()
  cases ~ Poisson(incidence)
})

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

simulate_epidemic <- function(N, gamma, I0, beta_values, beta_times,
                              T = 150, seed = 444) {
  set.seed(seed)
  obj  <- simple_sir()
  pars <- list(N = N, I0 = I0, gamma = gamma,
               n_beta      = length(beta_values),
               beta_times  = beta_times,
               beta_values = beta_values)
  sys <- dust2::dust_system_create(obj, pars, n_particles = 1, dt = 1)
  dust2::dust_system_set_state_initial(sys)
  y <- dust2::dust_system_simulate(sys, 0:T)
  list(
    incidence_df = data.frame(time  = 1:T,
                              cases = rpois(T, y[3, -1])),
    S_true       = y[1, -1],
    inc_true     = y[3, -1]
  )
}

compute_true_Rt <- function(beta_values, beta_times, gamma,
                            S_true, N, T = 150) {
  beta_t <- approx(beta_times + 1, beta_values, 1:T,
                   method = "constant", f = 0, rule = 2)$y
  (beta_t / gamma) * (S_true / N)
}

fit_scenario <- function(incidence_df, N, gamma, beta_breaks,
                         mean_beta, sd_beta = 0.7,
                         rw_sd_beta = 0.2, mean_I0, sd_I0 = 0.5,
                         n_steps = 15000, n_chains = 3) {
  estimate_R_blocks(
    data        = incidence_df,
    N           = N,
    gamma       = gamma,
    beta_breaks = beta_breaks,
    priors = list(
      mean_beta  = mean_beta,
      sd_beta    = sd_beta,
      rw_sd_beta = rw_sd_beta,
      mean_I0    = mean_I0,
      sd_I0      = sd_I0
    ),
    inits = list(
      beta = exp(mean_beta),
      I0   = exp(mean_I0)
    ),
    mcmc = list(n_steps  = n_steps,
                burnin   = 0.5,
                seed     = 444,
                n_chains = n_chains)
  )
}

coverage_stats <- function(Rt_true, lwr, upr, med,
                           scenario, label = "") {
  n       <- min(length(Rt_true), length(lwr), length(upr), length(med))
  covered <- Rt_true[1:n] >= lwr[1:n] & Rt_true[1:n] <= upr[1:n]
  data.frame(
    label     = label,
    scenario  = scenario,
    coverage  = round(mean(covered) * 100, 1),
    mean_bias = round(mean(med[1:n] - Rt_true[1:n]), 3),
    rmse      = round(sqrt(mean((med[1:n] - Rt_true[1:n])^2)), 3),
    ci_width  = round(mean(upr[1:n] - lwr[1:n]), 3)
  )
}

make_rt_plot <- function(out, Rt_true_df, title, subtitle = NULL,
                         vlines = NULL, colour = "#0072B2") {
  sub <- subtitle %||%
    "Blue = posterior median + 95% CI  |  Black dashed = true Rt  |  Red dotted = Rt=1"
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = out$Rt_quantiles,
                aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = colour, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = out$Rt_quantiles,
              aes(x = time, y = median),
              colour = colour, linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_line(data = Rt_true_df,
              aes(x = time, y = Rt),
              colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted",
               colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sub,
         x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt") +
    theme_val + theme(legend.position = "none")
  if (!is.null(vlines))
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = vlines, linetype = "dotted",
                        colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55)
  p
}

make_S_plot <- function(out, N, title, colour = "#56B4E9") {
  ggplot(out$S_quantiles, aes(x = time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                fill = colour, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = colour, linewidth = 1.0) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Posterior median and 95%% CI  |  N = %s",
                            format(N, big.mark = ",")),
         x = "Time (days)", y = "S(t)") +
    theme_val + theme(legend.position = "none")
}

# ============================================================
# ============================================================

s1 <- list(

)

# ============================================================

sim2 <- simulate_epidemic(s2$N, s2$gamma, s2$I0, s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times)

true_df_s1 <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_s1)
true_df_s2 <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_s2)

# ============================================================

cat("Fitting S1...\n")
out_s1 <- fit_scenario(sim1$incidence_df, s1$N, s1$gamma, s1$beta_breaks,
                       s1$mean_beta, mean_I0 = s1$mean_I0)

cat("Fitting S2...\n")

                       s2$mean_beta, mean_I0 = s2$mean_I0)

# ---- Main Rt plots ----

  geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dotted", colour="red", linewidth=0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=s1$vlines, linetype="dotted",
             colour="darkgrey", linewidth=0.55) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=misspec_colours_I0, name="Prior mean (I0)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values=misspec_colours_I0, name="Prior mean (I0)") +
  labs(title    = "C. I0 prior mean misspecification — S1: Gradual decline",
       subtitle = "Tests robustness when initial seed size is uncertain",
       x="Time (days)", y="Rt") +
  theme_val
print(p_I0_s1)

stats_I0 <- bind_rows(I0_stats)
cat("\n--- I0 misspec coverage ---\n")
print(stats_I0, row.names = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# D. COVERAGE VS N — S2 epidemic profile
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Analysis D: Coverage vs N (S2 profile) ---\n")

N_values <- c(1000, 5000, 20000, 100000, 500000, 5000000)

cov_n_stats <- list()

for (N_val in N_values) {
  cat(sprintf("  N = %s\n", format(N_val, big.mark = ",")))

  sim_n <- simulate_epidemic(N_val, s2$gamma, s2$I0,
                             s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times)
  Rt_true_n <- compute_true_Rt(s2$beta_values, s2$beta_times,
                               s2$gamma, sim_n$S_true, N_val)

  fit_n <- fit_scenario(sim_n$incidence_df, N_val, s2$gamma, s2$beta_breaks,
                        s2$mean_beta, mean_I0 = log(s2$I0),
                        n_steps = 10000)

  cov_n_stats[[as.character(N_val)]] <- coverage_stats(
    Rt_true_n,
    fit_n$Rt_quantiles$lwr,
    fit_n$Rt_quantiles$upr,
    fit_n$Rt_quantiles$median,
    scenario = "S2 profile",
    label    = format(N_val, big.mark = ",")
  ) |> mutate(N = N_val,
              pct_infected = round(sum(sim_n$incidence_df$cases) /
                                     N_val * 100, 1))
}

df_cov_n <- bind_rows(cov_n_stats)
cat("\n--- Coverage vs N ---\n")
print(df_cov_n[, c("N", "pct_infected", "coverage",
                   "mean_bias", "rmse", "ci_width")],
      row.names = FALSE)

# Coverage vs N plot
p_cov_n <- ggplot(df_cov_n, aes(x = log10(N))) +
  geom_line(aes(y = coverage), colour = "#0072B2", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = coverage), colour = "#0072B2", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 95, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = log10(N_values),
    labels = format(N_values, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  ) +
  labs(title    = "D. Coverage vs population size — S2 epidemic profile",
       subtitle = "Red dashed = nominal 95% coverage  |  x-axis on log10 scale",
       x = "Population size (N)", y = "Coverage (%)") +
  theme_val +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

p_ci_n <- ggplot(df_cov_n, aes(x = log10(N))) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ci_width), colour = "#E69F00", linewidth = 1.1) +

p_pct_n <- ggplot(df_cov_n, aes(x = pct_infected, y = coverage)) +

print(p_cov_n)

fig_covN <- (p_cov_n | p_ci_n | p_pct_n) +

    title = "D. Coverage and CI width as a function of population size (S2 profile)",

print(fig_covN)

# ============================================================
# E. CONVERGENCE DIAGNOSTICS — S1 only
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Analysis E: Convergence diagnostics (S1) ---\n")

# Extract raw samples array: [n_pars x n_steps x n_chains]
samp_arr  <- out_s1$samples$pars   # dim: [K+1, n_steps_post_burnin, n_chains]
par_names <- dimnames(samp_arr)[[1]]
if (is.null(par_names))
  par_names <- c(sprintf("beta_%d", seq_len(dim(samp_arr)[1] - 1)), "I0")

n_pars   <- dim(samp_arr)[1]
n_steps  <- dim(samp_arr)[2]
n_chains <- dim(samp_arr)[3]

# ---- Trace plots ----
trace_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(ch) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n_pars), function(p) {
    data.frame(
      step   = seq_len(n_steps),
      value  = samp_arr[p, , ch],
      param  = par_names[p],
      chain  = factor(ch)
    )
  }))
}))

p_trace <- ggplot(trace_df, aes(x = step, y = value, colour = chain)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ param, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73"),
                      name = "Chain") +
  labs(title    = "E. Trace plots — S1: Gradual decline",
       subtitle = "Post-burnin samples across 3 chains  |  Good mixing = overlapping chains",
       x = "Post-burnin iteration", y = "Parameter value") +
  theme_val +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
print(p_trace)

# ---- Posterior density plots ----
p_dens <- ggplot(trace_df, aes(x = value, colour = chain, fill = chain)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ param, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73"), name = "Chain") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73"), name = "Chain") +
  labs(title    = "E. Posterior densities — S1: Gradual decline",
       subtitle = "Chains should overlap — divergence indicates mixing problems",
       x = "Parameter value", y = "Density") +
  theme_val +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9))
print(p_dens)

# ---- R-hat and ESS via coda ----
# Convert to coda mcmc.list
mcmc_list <- coda::mcmc.list(
  lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(ch) {
    mat <- t(samp_arr[, , ch])  # [n_steps x n_pars]
    colnames(mat) <- par_names
    coda::mcmc(mat)
  })
)

rhat_vals <- coda::gelman.diag(mcmc_list, multivariate = FALSE)$psrf
ess_vals  <- coda::effectiveSize(mcmc_list)

diag_df <- data.frame(
  parameter   = par_names,
  R_hat       = round(rhat_vals[, 1], 3),
  R_hat_upper = round(rhat_vals[, 2], 3),
  ESS         = round(ess_vals, 0)
)

cat("\n--- Convergence diagnostics (S1) ---\n")
cat("R-hat < 1.01 indicates good convergence\n")
cat("ESS > 400 is generally sufficient\n\n")
print(diag_df, row.names = FALSE)

# R-hat plot
p_rhat <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = reorder(parameter, R_hat), y = R_hat)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = R_hat < 1.05), width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = R_hat, ymax = R_hat_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.01, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.05, linetype = "dotted",
             colour = "orange", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#009E73", "FALSE" = "#D55E00"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "< 1.05 (acceptable)",
                               "FALSE" = ">= 1.05 (concern)"),
                    name = "R-hat") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title    = "E. R-hat convergence diagnostic — S1",
       subtitle = "Red dashed = 1.01 (target)  |  Orange dotted = 1.05 (warning threshold)",
       x = NULL, y = "R-hat") +
  theme_val

p_ess <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = reorder(parameter, ESS), y = ESS)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = ESS > 400), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 400, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "red", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#009E73", "FALSE" = "#D55E00"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "> 400 (sufficient)",
                               "FALSE" = "<= 400 (low)"),
                    name = "ESS") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title    = "E. Effective sample size — S1",
       subtitle = "Red dashed = 400 (practical minimum)",
       x = NULL, y = "Effective sample size") +
  theme_val

print(p_rhat)
print(p_ess)

fig_conv <- (p_trace / (p_rhat | p_ess)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "E. MCMC convergence diagnostics — S1: Gradual decline",
    subtitle = "Trace plots, R-hat, and effective sample sizes across 3 chains",
    theme    = theme(plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
                     plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))
  )
print(fig_conv)

# ============================================================
# F. CHANGE-POINT TIMING SENSITIVITY — S2 only
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Analysis F: Change-point timing sensitivity (S2) ---\n")

# 1) Define three break variants: correct, early (-7d), late (+7d)
cp_s2 <- list(
  list(label = "Correct", breaks = s2$beta_breaks),
  list(label = "Early (-7d)", breaks = pmax(1, s2$beta_breaks - 7)),
  list(label = "Late (+7d)",  breaks = s2$beta_breaks + 7)
)

# 2) Fit all three with identical priors/mcmc
cp_runs  <- list()
cp_stats <- list()
for (cpi in cp_s2) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s break schedule: %s\n",
              cpi$label, paste(cpi$breaks, collapse = ", ")))
  fit <- fit_scenario(
    incidence_df = sim2$incidence_df,
    N            = s2$N,
    gamma        = s2$gamma,
    beta_breaks  = cpi$breaks,
    mean_beta    = s2$mean_beta,
    mean_I0      = s2$mean_I0,
    rw_sd_beta   = 0.2,     # same as main fit
    sd_beta      = 0.7,
    sd_I0        = 0.5,
    n_steps      = 15000,
    n_chains     = 3
  )
  cp_runs[[cpi$label]]  <- fit
  cp_stats[[cpi$label]] <- coverage_stats(
    Rt_true      = Rt_true_s2,
    lwr          = fit$Rt_quantiles$lwr,
    upr          = fit$Rt_quantiles$upr,
    med          = fit$Rt_quantiles$median,
    scenario     = "S2",
    label        = cpi$label
  )
}

# 3) Tables
stats_cp <- dplyr::bind_rows(cp_stats) |>
  dplyr::select(label, scenario, coverage, mean_bias, rmse, ci_width) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Break schedule` = label,
    Scenario         = scenario,
    `Coverage (%)`   = coverage,
    `Mean bias`      = mean_bias,
    RMSE             = rmse,
    `CI width`       = ci_width
  )

cat("\n--- Change-point timing sensitivity (S2) ---\n")
print(stats_cp, row.names = FALSE)

# 4) Overlay plot
cp_overlay_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(names(cp_runs), function(nm) {
    cp_runs[[nm]]$Rt_quantiles |> dplyr::mutate(schedule = nm)
  })
)

p_cp_overlay <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = dplyr::filter(cp_overlay_df, schedule == "Correct"),
              aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = "Correct"), alpha = 0.28) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dplyr::filter(cp_overlay_df, schedule == "Early (-7d)"),
              aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = "Early (-7d)"), alpha = 0.32) +
  geom_ribbon(data = dplyr::filter(cp_overlay_df, schedule == "Late (+7d)"),
              aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = "Late (+7d)"), alpha = 0.36) +
  geom_line(data = cp_overlay_df, aes(x = time, y = median, colour = schedule), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(data = true_df_s2, aes(x = time, y = Rt), colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = s2$vlines, linetype = "dotted", colour = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.55) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Correct" = "#009E73", "Early (-7d)" = "#E69F00", "Late (+7d)" = "#56B4E9"),
                    name = "Break schedule") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Correct" = "#009E73", "Early (-7d)" = "#E69F00", "Late (+7d)" = "#56B4E9"),
                      name = "Break schedule") +
  labs(title = "F. Change-point timing sensitivity — S2: COVID-19 lockdown",
       subtitle = "Dashed black = true Rt, dotted grey = true change-point at day 45",
       x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt") +
  theme_val

print(p_cp_overlay)

# 5) Individual plots (optional, useful for appendix)
p_cp_correct <- make_rt_plot(cp_runs[["Correct"]], true_df_s2,
                             title = "S2 Rt — Correct break schedule",
                             vlines = s2$vlines, colour = "#009E73")
p_cp_early   <- make_rt_plot(cp_runs[["Early (-7d)"]], true_df_s2,
                             title = "S2 Rt — Early breaks (-7 days)",
                             vlines = s2$vlines, colour = "#E69F00")
p_cp_late    <- make_rt_plot(cp_runs[["Late (+7d)"]], true_df_s2,
                             title = "S2 Rt — Late breaks (+7 days)",
                             vlines = s2$vlines, colour = "#56B4E9")

print(p_cp_correct); print(p_cp_early); print(p_cp_late)

# 6) Save key objects for report use
cp_results_table <- stats_cp

# ============================================================
# G. CHANGE-POINT TIMING SENSITIVITY — S2 profile at SMALLER N
#     shows full credible intervals (fixes the S2 CI collapse)
# ============================================================

cat("\n--- Analysis G: ±7-day CP sensitivity at SMALLER N (S2 profile) ---\n")

# Choose small N values here:
N_small_vals <- c(20000)   # add 5000 if you want: c(20000, 5000)

# Store everything
cp_small_runs  <- list()
cp_small_stats <- list()
cp_small_plots <- list()

for (N_small in N_small_vals) {

  # Scale I0 relative to S2 prevalence
  I0_scaled <- max(1L, round(s2$I0 * (N_small / s2$N)))

  cat(sprintf("\n--- Fitting small-N S2 scenario: N=%s (I0=%d) ---\n",
              format(N_small, big.mark=","), I0_scaled))

  # Simulate epidemic with same S2 abrupt drop
  sim_small <- simulate_epidemic(
    N          = N_small,
    gamma      = s2$gamma,
    I0         = I0_scaled,
    beta_values= s2$beta_values,
    beta_times = s2$beta_times
  )

  Rt_true_small <- compute_true_Rt(
    beta_values = s2$beta_values,
    beta_times  = s2$beta_times,
    gamma       = s2$gamma,
    S_true      = sim_small$S_true,
    N           = N_small
  )
  true_df_small <- data.frame(time = 1:150, Rt = Rt_true_small)

  # Break schedules (correct, early, late)
  cp_variants <- list(
    list(label = "Correct",    breaks = s2$beta_breaks),
    list(label = "Early (-7d)",breaks = pmax(1, s2$beta_breaks - 7)),
    list(label = "Late (+7d)", breaks = s2$beta_breaks + 7)
  )

  # Fit each CP variant
  for (cpv in cp_variants) {
    cat(sprintf("  CP variant: %s at N=%s\n",
                cpv$label, format(N_small, big.mark=",")))

    fit <- fit_scenario(
      incidence_df = sim_small$incidence_df,
      N            = N_small,
      gamma        = s2$gamma,
      beta_breaks  = cpv$breaks,
      mean_beta    = s2$mean_beta,
      mean_I0      = log(I0_scaled),
      rw_sd_beta   = 0.2,
      sd_beta      = 0.7,
      sd_I0        = 0.5,
      n_steps      = 15000,
      n_chains     = 3
    )

    # Store
    key <- paste0(cpv$label, "_N", N_small)
    cp_small_runs[[key]] <- list(fit = fit, truth = true_df_small)

    cp_small_stats[[key]] <- coverage_stats(
      Rt_true_small,
      fit$Rt_quantiles$lwr,
      fit$Rt_quantiles$upr,
      fit$Rt_quantiles$median,
      scenario = paste0("S2 small N=", format(N_small, big.mark=",")),
      label    = cpv$label
    )

    # Individual plot
    cp_small_plots[[key]] <- make_rt_plot(
      fit,
      true_df_small,
      title  = paste0("S2 Rt — ", cpv$label, " (N=", format(N_small, big.mark=","), ")"),
      vlines = s2$vlines,
      colour = if (cpv$label == "Correct") "#009E73"
      else if (cpv$label == "Early (-7d)") "#E69F00"
      else "#56B4E9"
    )
  }

  # Combined overlay for this N_small
  df_overlay_small <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(cp_variants, function(cpv) {
      key <- paste0(cpv$label, "_N", N_small)
      cp_small_runs[[key]]$fit$Rt_quantiles |>
        dplyr::mutate(schedule = cpv$label)
    })
  )

  p_overlay_small <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = df_overlay_small,
                aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = schedule),
                alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line(data = df_overlay_small,
              aes(x = time, y = median, colour = schedule), linewidth = 1.0) +
    geom_line(data = true_df_small, aes(x=time, y=Rt),
              colour="black", linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = s2$vlines, linetype="dotted",
               colour="darkgrey", linewidth=0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype="dotted",
               colour="red", linewidth=0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Correct"    = "#009E73",
      "Early (-7d)"= "#E69F00",
      "Late (+7d)" = "#56B4E9"
    ), name = "Break schedule") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "Correct"    = "#009E73",
      "Early (-7d)"= "#E69F00",
      "Late (+7d)" = "#56B4E9"
    ), name = "Break schedule") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("G. Change-point sensitivity at N=", format(N_small, big.mark=",")),
      subtitle = "Smaller N → visible credible intervals → clearer CP misalignment effects",
      x = "Time (days)", y = "Rt"
    ) + theme_val

  print(p_overlay_small)
}
# Combine stats
stats_cp_small <- dplyr::bind_rows(cp_small_stats)
cat("\n--- Summary: small-N ±7-day CP sensitivity ---\n")
print(stats_cp_small, row.names=FALSE)
```
